summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on 4 September 2026, announcing daily share repurchases executed by Goldman Sachs International under its existing buyback programmes announced on 30 January 2026 and 31 July 2026. Between 1 and 4 September 2026, the bank purchased approximately 37.6 million ordinary shares at prices ranging from 108.2 to 112.7 pence per share, with volume-weighted averages between 109.7944 and 112.3555 pence. The shares will be cancelled, reducing the total share count. This is a routine issuer open-market buyback disclosure under UK regulations, representing ongoing capital return to shareholders. Watch for continued execution pace and any programme completion announcements.
